D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Mike Levin leads by 31.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 79,368 votes; a one point swing is about 1,282 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +23.8 and D +38.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.5M cash against $18K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
